recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly high-angle portrait of a man in a brown cowboy hat and white t-shirt, leaning against a vintage bed frame in a soft-lit, airy room, with clean serif typography positioned in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: The brown of the hat anchors the warm tones against the cool, bright background.
The diagonal lean of the subject creates a relaxed, informal composition.
The typography spans the horizontal width of the upper frame, balancing the subject's weight below.
Soft window light from the right creates gentle modeling on the face and fabric.
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a wide-brimmed felt hat

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark brown cowboy hat serves as the primary focal point and highest contrast element.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the dark hat, move down to the subject's face, then follow the shoulder line up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is kept relatively clear to accommodate secondary text and light flare.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and pale blue (background and shirt) providing a clean, bright base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown (hat) providing structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle blue-violet for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high brightness; the hat is the only low-value, high-density element.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and airy pastels

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a mix of Title Case and All-Caps
High stroke contrast in the main title
Wide tracking for secondary subtitle text
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyph forms used for legibility

composition.position: Top edge, spanning left to center

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A high-contrast display serif paired with a widely-spaced, low-contrast secondary serif for a sophisticated, modern-country feel.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top third

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, high-contrast serif look for the primary title.
Suitable for the all-caps, widely spaced subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in his 30s with a relaxed expression, wearing a dark brown felt cowboy hat and a plain white t-shirt. He is leaning against a white vintage metal bed frame. The lighting is soft, bright, and natural, coming from a window on the right, creating a high-key atmosphere with slight lens flare in the upper right corner. The background is softly blurred.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a large Serif font at the top, using white for the first word and dark brown for the second. Below it, right-aligned, add the subtitle in a smaller, all-caps serif font with wide letter spacing in a muted blue-violet color.

verificationChecks: Is the hat the darkest element in the frame?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?
Is the lighting high-key and airy?

adjustableVariables: Typography color (matching the hat vs matching the background)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any specific artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Check that the hat does not obscure the subject's eyes too much.
Verify the color of the second title word matches the hat.
Confirm the wide tracking on the subtitle is preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in iconic headwear + soft high-key interior + split-color serif title + wide-tracked subtitle.
